note: The Soft Life website's words (site/ builds the page from this file). Cursor owns the wording. Houses come from data/campusville/houses.json (name, vibe, blurb, colours), the day's times from data/campusville/meta.json phases, and the Organt shop link from data/campusville/shop.json url, so none of those are repeated here. {game} in any line becomes the game's address without https:// (gameUrl below). Images live in site/public/img/ as WebP (site/scripts/images.mjs makes them from site/img-src/); an image that isn't there yet shows the drawn tee instead. brands.email empty = the For brands section is hidden. organt.showShop false = the Shop Organt button is hidden even with a link in shop.json (7 Nov: organt.shop says Store unavailable; set it to true when the store is open). next.show false = the Coming next section is hidden. Rules: no real university names or logos, no real brands except Organt, no invented numbers.

meta.title: Soft Life: first year at the University of Mzansi
meta.description: A free 3D campus life sim that plays in your phone's browser. Pick one of seven houses, get your student number, and live first year with real students from across Mzansi.
meta.shareAlt: Soft Life: University of Mzansi. Students from the seven houses on the campus steps.

hero.title: First year at the University of Mzansi
hero.text: A free 3D campus life sim that plays in your phone's browser. Pick one of seven houses, get your student number, and live first year with real students from across Mzansi.

card.label: Your UMzansi student card
card.note: Yours when you enrol. The first 500 students get the Founders badge on their card.

poster.alt: The Soft Life poster: students in Wave, Peak, Oakwinds, Goldrush, Kingsway and Jakaranda colours and Organt tees on the campus steps, under the house banners.

day.title: A day on campus
day.text: Your day runs on the clock, in the same six slots. Keep your money, energy, fullness, grades and social from running low.

wake.label: Wake
wake.text: The alarm goes off in res. Your roommate is already up.

transit.label: Go
transit.text: Walk to campus and join the caf queue for breakfast.

lecture.label: Lecture
lecture.text: Sit in, stay awake, keep your grades up.

social.label: Social
social.text: Hit the Quad, meet people and chat with whoever's around.

leisure.label: Free
leisure.text: Shop at Greenway Grocer, stock the house fridge or pick up a shift.

night.label: Night
night.text: Back to your house common room, or out with your crew.

houses.title: Seven houses. Pick yours.
houses.text: Every student lives in a house. It's your crew, your common room and your colours for the year.

organt.title: Only Organt on campus
organt.text: Every outfit in Soft Life is a real Organt design. See it on campus, then wear it for real.

lookbook.alt: Organt's new limited collection: five people in Area Code tees (021, 011, 031) and Matcha Girly baby tees.
lookbook.heading: New

items.name: Area Code tee
items.text: Washed black, in 011, 012, 021 and 031. Rep where you're from.
items.alt: The Area Code tee in washed black with 021 across the chest.

items.name: Jozi Number 10
items.text: Forest green and mustard, with joggers to match.
items.alt: The Jozi Number 10 tee in forest green, with Jozi Number 10 across the chest in mustard.

items.name: Matcha Girly baby tee
items.text: Cropped, in tan, white or brown.
items.alt: The Matcha Girly baby tee, cropped, in tan.

organt.note: Coming to the game: your first tee is your hometown's area code. Durban gets 031.

phone.title: Put Soft Life on your phone
phone.text: No app store and no big download. It goes on your home screen straight from your browser and opens like an app.

android.title: Android
steps: Tap the three-dot menu at the top right.
Tap Install app, or Add to home screen.

iphone.title: iPhone
steps: Tap the Share button at the bottom.

phone.qr: On a computer? Scan this with your phone camera to play.
phone.qrAlt: QR code to play Soft Life at {game}

items.name: UMzansi FM
items.text: Campus radio that everyone hears at the same moment, playing South African producers.

items.name: Chats that stay
items.text: Message your friends and your house group. Your conversations are waiting when you come back.

items.name: Clubs
items.text: Start a club for anything, from science jokes to Sunday soccer, with its own spot on campus.

brands.title: Reach South African students
brands.text: Sponsored hunts, campus events and slots on UMzansi FM. Built into the game, never in the way.
brands.subject: Soft Life: brands

footer.text: The University of Mzansi, its houses and its students are fictional. Clothing by Organt.
